units: Num. R. s. 10 תהא בנ׳ (Sabb. 64ᵇ, a. e. בנדתה), v. נִדָּה.—Esp. excommunication, of a higher degree than נְזִיפָה and lesser than חֵרֶם.
M. Kat. 16ᵃ אין נ׳ פחות וכ׳ nidduy lasts no less than thirty days.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 16a:18">Ib.</cite> <he>נִידּוּיוֹ נ׳</he> the excommunication pronounced by him is valid.
<cite ref="Berakhot 19a:11">Ber. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>גוזרני עליך נ׳</he> I should have decreed the ban over; a. fr.
